# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by `npm run env:docs` from lib/env.ts. Edit the descriptions there; CI fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every variable the app reads. `example.env` lists the same variables with development values.

- **Required in production**: "yes (boot check)" means a production server logs `env.invalid` with the
  variable's name and exits with code 1 when it is missing (`checkProductionEnv` in `lib/env.ts`). It
  also exits when `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` is short or a known placeholder, when either URL is not https
  (unless `ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP=true`), and when `SETUP_TOKEN` is shorter than 16 characters.
  "yes" means the app cannot run without it, though the boot check does not test it.
- **Docker Compose** also reads `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` and `REDIS_PASSWORD`, which it passes to Postgres and
  Redis; see [deployment](deployment.md). The app itself never reads them.
- **`DEV_*`** variables prefill the setup wizard in development only; `example.env` lists them.
- **Test only** variables are for the test suites and must never be set in production.

See [deployment](deployment.md) for an install and [domain move](domain-move.md) for changing the URL.

## Core

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXTAUTH_URL` | yes |  | The app's URL, for NextAuth callbacks and session cookies. https in production; cookies are Secure exactly when it is https. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` |  | `NEXTAUTH_URL` | Public URL for share links and OG images; same origin as NEXTAUTH_URL. A bare-metal install rebuilds after changing it, because Next inlines it at build time. |
| `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | yes (boot check) |  | Signs session cookies. At least 32 random characters: openssl rand -base64 32. |
| `PLEX_CLIENT_IDENTIFIER` | yes (boot check) |  | Unique id this install reports to Plex: openssl rand -hex 16. Keep it stable; Jellyfin's default device id is derived from it. |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEYS` | yes (boot check) |  | Keyring for secrets stored at rest: comma-separated kid:base64 entries of 32 bytes each (openssl rand -base64 32). The first encrypts new writes; the others only read. Production also starts with ENCRYPTION_KEY alone, or with ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_SECRETS=true. Keep every key in a password manager, never beside a database dump; rotation and lost-key recovery are in docs/operations.md. |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` |  |  | Older single key for stored secrets, at least 32 characters: openssl rand -hex 32. Never reuse NEXTAUTH_SECRET. It still reads what it wrote. Without ENCRYPTION_KEYS, it encrypts new writes as kid legacy. To move to ENCRYPTION_KEYS, see docs/operations.md. |
| `ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_SECRETS` |  | `false` | UNSAFE. "true" lets production start without a strong encryption key; every boot warns and secrets are stored as plain text. |
| `SETUP_TOKEN` |  |  | Claims first-run setup instead of the code printed in the log. At least 16 characters: openssl rand -hex 16. |
| `ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP` |  | `false` | "true" lets production run on plain http (LAN only). Cookies are then not Secure; never set it on an install reachable from the internet. |
| `HSTS_MAX_AGE` |  | `31536000` | Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds, sent only when NEXTAUTH_URL is https. The boot check refuses anything but a whole number. |
| `HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS` |  | `false` | "true" adds includeSubDomains to Strict-Transport-Security. Set it only when every subdomain serves https. |
| `HSTS_PRELOAD` |  | `false` | "true" adds preload to Strict-Transport-Security, for the browsers' preload list. Hard to undo: read hstspreload.org first. |
| `CSP_REPORT_ONLY` |  | `false` | "true" sends the Content Security Policy as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: violations reach /api/csp-report but are not blocked. For a rollout or a suspected policy fault only. |
| `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` |  | `1` | Reverse proxies that append to X-Forwarded-For: 1 for one proxy, 2 for a CDN in front of it, 0 for none. A wrong value lets clients pick their rate-limit address. |
| `TZ` |  | `UTC` | Server time zone (IANA name) until one is saved in Admin settings, which overrides it. |

## Database

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | yes |  | PostgreSQL connection string. ?schema= picks the Postgres schema for migrations and the app alike; change it only before the first migration. |
| `SKIP_MIGRATIONS` |  | `false` | Docker image only: "true" starts without applying migrations; the entrypoint still logs prisma migrate status. |
| `PROCESS_ROLE` |  | `all` | web, worker or all: what this container runs, and the database pool defaults below. web serves pages only; worker runs the queues, schedulers and Discord bot and serves only /api/health and /api/metrics; all does both in one container (docs/examples/docker-compose.workers.yml). The boot check refuses any other value. |
| `DB_POOL_MAX` |  | `10 web, 5 worker, 12 all` | Database pool size. The Prisma 7 pg adapter ignores ?connection_limit= in DATABASE_URL. |
| `DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS` |  | `10000` | How long a query waits for a free database connection. |
| `DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` |  | `15000 web, 120000 worker, 60000 all` | Statement timeout in milliseconds. |

## Background work

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REDIS_URL` |  |  | Redis for the job queue and rate limits, redis://:password@host:6379. Rewind and Stripe need it. |
| `ENABLE_QUEUE_WORKER` |  | `true` | "false" turns the BullMQ worker off in this process (on by default when REDIS_URL is set). |
| `QUEUE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY` |  | `5` | Jobs the worker runs at once. |
| `ENABLE_DISCORD_BOT` |  | `true` | "false" opts this process out of the Discord bot. Otherwise it starts once Admin, Discord, "Bot enabled" is on and a token exists, with no restart. One process runs it, under a database lock. |
| `DISCORD_BOT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` |  | `10000` | How often to try for the bot lock and re-check settings. |
| `ENABLE_WATCHLIST_SYNC` |  | `true` | "false" turns the polling watchlist sync off when Redis is not set. |
| `WATCHLIST_SYNC_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` |  | `60000` | How often the polling watchlist sync checks its lock. |
| `SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS` |  | `8000` | How long SIGTERM waits for jobs, the bot and connections before exiting (below Docker's 10 s stop timeout). |

## Observability

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LOG_LEVEL` |  | `info in production, else debug` | error, warn, info, verbose, debug or silly. |
| `METRICS_TOKEN` |  |  | Bearer token for /api/metrics; without it the route answers 404: openssl rand -hex 32. |
| `BUILD_COMMIT` |  |  | Git commit /api/metrics reports in build_info (the image sets it at build time). |

## Data retention

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RETENTION_REWIND_LLM_TEXT_DAYS` |  | `120` | Days Rewind AI prompts and replies keep their text. |
| `RETENTION_ASSISTANT_LLM_TEXT_DAYS` |  | `90` | Days assistant prompts and replies keep their text. |
| `RETENTION_ASSISTANT_CHAT_DAYS` |  | `90` | Idle days before an assistant page conversation leaves its owner's history. |
| `RETENTION_CHAT_CONVERSATION_DAYS` |  | `180` | Days an ended assistant conversation is kept. |
| `RETENTION_DISCORD_CHAT_MESSAGES_DAYS` |  | `1` | Idle days before a Discord chat's stored turns are emptied. |
| `RETENTION_DISCORD_CHAT_SESSION_DAYS` |  | `30` | Idle days before a Discord chat session is deleted. |
| `RETENTION_DISCORD_COMMAND_ARGS_DAYS` |  | `7` | Days Discord command arguments are kept. |
| `RETENTION_DISCORD_COMMAND_LOG_DAYS` |  | `90` | Days Discord command log rows are kept. |
| `RETENTION_SHARE_VISITS_DAYS` |  | `90` | Days Rewind share-link daily visit counts are kept. |
| `RETENTION_REWIND_VIEW_DAYS` |  | `120` | Days Rewind reading records are kept. |
| `RETENTION_WATCHLIST_REMOVED_DAYS` |  | `30` | Days a title removed from a watchlist stays in sync history. |
| `RETENTION_DISCORD_OAUTH_STATE_DAYS` |  | `1` | Days an expired Discord link attempt is kept. |
| `RETENTION_AUDIT_LOG_DAYS` |  | `400` | Days audit log rows are kept. |
| `RETENTION_AFFILIATE_DAYS` |  | `365` | Days refused, revoked and closed affiliate applications and unused affiliate invites are kept. |

## Integrations

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` |  |  | Discord bot token, used when none is stored in Admin settings. |
| `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID` |  |  | Discord application id for the slash-command and metadata scripts. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_DISCORD_CLIENT_ID` |  |  | Discord application id the scripts fall back to. |
| `DISCORD_GUILD_ID` |  |  | Registers slash commands in one Discord server, instantly, instead of globally. |
| `DISCORD_SUPPORT_CHANNEL_ID` |  |  | Support channel id, used when none is stored in Admin settings. |
| `DISCORD_SUPPORT_THREAD_IDS` |  |  | Comma-separated support thread ids, used when none are stored in Admin settings. |
| `DISCORD_PORTAL_URL` |  | `<base>/discord/link` | Account-linking URL in Discord nudges. |
| `PLEX_WRAPPED_BASE_URL` |  |  | First choice for the Discord portal base URL, before NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL and NEXTAUTH_URL. |
| `JELLYFIN_DEVICE_ID` |  | `plex-manager-<16 hex characters>` | DeviceId reported to Jellyfin at sign-in. Leave unset: the default is derived from PLEX_CLIENT_IDENTIFIER. |
| `LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` |  | `300000` | LLM request timeout in milliseconds. |

## Rewind

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REWIND_CACHE_DIR` |  | `.next/cache/rewind` | Rewind poster, card and font cache, resolved against the working directory. It can be rebuilt, so it needs no backup. |
| `REWIND_STAGING` |  |  | Staging only: "1" lets the season-open rehearsal run (npm run rewind:season-open -- --rehearse). Never set in production. |

## Test only

| Variable | Required in production | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `E2E_TEST_MODE` |  |  | Test only: "true" arms the seed outside production. Never set it in .env; pass it inline. |
| `E2E_DATABASE_URL` |  |  | Test only: the Playwright database; its name must end in _test, and the suite wipes it. |
| `E2E_PORT` |  | `3100` | Test only: the Playwright web server port. |
| `SKIP_CONNECTION_TESTS` |  |  | Test only: "true" skips live Plex checks. |
| `ENABLE_DEV_UI` |  |  | Development only: "1" serves the /dev/ui primitives sheet (Playwright sets it). |
